meta.geography_note: The subject parcel's street address, APN and legal description are withheld by policy. All geography in this file is City of Los Angeles, Los Angeles County, or the Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim metropolitan area. No parcel-level value, rent, or hazard class is asserted anywhere in this file.

status_definitions.verified: Value read directly, on 2026-11-07, from the official source in the source column. The exact figure and its period are reproduced here.
status_definitions.computed: Arithmetic performed only on verified values. The formula and the input row ids are given in the note.
status_definitions.unverified: No official source could confirm a value. The value cell is blank by rule. Nothing was inferred, interpolated, or substituted from an aggregator.
status_definitions.given: Supplied by the owner in the brief (not a sourced data point). Subject to confirmation against documents.
